text:
mia: Heads up — i'm about to merge a tiny snapshot+tiling tweak (no allocator API changes) but the canary shows ~4% p95 bump on 4kseq. attaching bench link. can someone give quick eyes before i hit merge? :eyes:

raj: can you drop the canary artifact link and the exact config you used? p95 numbers and sample sizes please.

mia: https://artifacts/redwood/bench/1729456789/canary.html
p95 baseline=210ms, canary=218ms, n=1200 requests across 6 hosts. same traffic generator. config: `snapshot-tiling-v2` (small prefetch change).

tyler: thanks. did we see any p50 or throughput regressions or is it tail-only?

mia: p50 stable (92ms vs 93ms). throughput flat within noise. tail shifted mostly at sequence lengths > 2k.

olga: can you paste the bench command you ran so we can repro locally?

mia: sure — run locally with the docker harness:

```
bench-run --model=gpt-j --seq=4096 --iters=500 --concurrency=8 --config=snapshot-tiling-v2.json 
```

ci-bot: canary deployment 1729456789: completed on 6 hosts — 0 failed checks, 2 warnings (low sampling on host-a, host-d).

sam: quick thought — could the prefetch change increase lock contention on KV shards for long sequences? saw similar before with aggressive prefetch.

raj: +1 to that hypothesis. can you capture a perf profile (async cpu/gpu timelines) for an offending run? a single flamegraph and nvprof samplings would help.

tyler: also try disabling prefetch (fallback to snapshot-tiling-v1) in the same canary to confirm causality. easy to toggle via route override.

mia: i can run a profiling pass now. plan: 1) repro with bench-run (command above) 2) collect nvprof + flamegraph 3) run canary with prefetch off and compare. will hold merge until we have at least one profiling run or until 30m auto-revert.

olga: sounds good. if the profile points to KV lock waits we should consider a micro-tiling config that reduces prefetch window for >2k seq.

sam: if you need a quick rollback plan: add a rollout block in deploy with immediate revert on p95_regress > 2.5%. i can patch the deploy rule.

mia: appreciated — if anyone can spare 20m to watch the profile and help triage, ping me. starting the run now. :coffee:

raj: i'll grab the flamegraphs in ~15 and post findings.

tyler: i'll try the route-override test on my sandbox and post results.

ci-bot: bench job 1729456795 queued. artifact will appear at /artifacts/1729456795 when complete.

mia: update — first profiling run done, upload at https://artifacts/redwood/bench/1729456795/profile.html. early look: increased kernel queueing on host-d during kv-evict phase.

raj: looking — i see a sharp spike in cuda memcpy time aligned with evict. that could explain tail.

sam: ok let's hold merge. mia, if you want i can flip the rollback rule now so the canary will auto-revert on the next evaluation.

mia: please do, thanks. i'll open a quick PR with the micro-tiling tweak disabled and attach perf diffs.

olga: follow-up: add the bench command and a tiny reproducer snippet to the PR description so reviewers can run locally.

mia: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

tyler: ping me when PR is up, i'll do a quick perf + code review.

ci-bot: deploy rule updated: auto-revert p95_regress threshold=2.5% by sam.

mia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/9123 — includes perf artifacts and plan. requesting 2 reviewers.

raj: on it.

--- end of thread ---
